resume: Six-voice granular instrument with synthesized sources, captured samples, LFO/envelope modulation, pitch and time shifting, rhythmic gestures, delay and reverb. SEQ is a performance TAPIS, not a conventional note sequencer.
commandes: Lower keyboard octave or cancel a confirmation.
Raise octave or confirm a save.
Filter, echo, space, halo and texture pages.
Envelope pages; hold while turning a knob to add envelope modulation.
LFO pages; hold while turning a knob to add LFO modulation.
Grain, texture, drone and chaos pages.
Global tempo and clock, capture and randomization controls.
Cloud view and performance; hold to freeze the playhead.
Save the current patch into a chosen preset slot.
Toggle TAPIS, making white keys sample positions and black keys performance pads.
Start or stop the clock used for rhythmic effects.
Capture the sound; hold and turn a knob to record a looping gesture.
Choose among available factory and user presets.
Adjust playback speed, including reverse and frozen-position settings.
Play notes or, in TAPIS, select sample positions and temporary granular effects.
gestes: Hold LFO or ENV and turn one of the four knobs to modulate that destination.
Toggle SEQ: sixteen white keys become sample positions and eleven black keys become performance effects.
Press REC to capture the current output or hold REC while turning a knob to record its movement.

modes.texte: The keyboard acts as a playable sample map and performance pad bank, rather than an ordinary step sequencer.

a_savoir: This build pins the public 0.2 development snapshot; upstream has not published a tagged stable 0.2 release.
Captured sound and other saved data may be affected by the FM-1 app's known Power Off persistence bug.
